summary: legal checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; keep private and preview-only. Woot documentation confirms API access and rate limits, but current terms do not evidence commercial/public redistribution, storage, derivatives, price/image display, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights. Privacy, consent, vendor, security, accuracy, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Do not send rights outreach or change the private gate without owner authorization and human-counsel review. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only when it adds no new data collection, permissions, credentials, dependencies, or cross-site behavior.

Compliance and data-quality evidence is a technical baseline, not certification: 35 sites pass, 20 fail, and 6 are unknown; open findings include banner, consent choice, GA4, privacy, and terms checks. Analytics is broadly configured. Revenue attribution is yellow because $4.92 aggregate Amazon commission cannot be assigned to a site. Do not block ordinary growth solely for incomplete telemetry, but block new public exposure or monetization expansion where rights, disclosure, consent, claims, or provenance evidence is absent.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. No SearchWoot legal task is closed: source rights, data flow and retention, GA4 consent/configuration, and logs/vendors/incident handling all lack required evidence. Next evidence action: produce one dated read-only bundle covering those four areas from repository, deployed configuration, and authoritative terms; do not enable tracking, collect new data, send external outreach, or change production.

items.title: Maintain SearchWoot private launch gate and complete legal evidence bundle
items.summary: Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. The current evidence supports a blocked disposition for public beta or full launch because Woot rights for public/commercial data use are not established and privacy, consent, security, accuracy, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete.
items.requested_action: Continue the four existing launch-readiness legal tasks. Produce one dated read-only evidence bundle covering source rights and field permissions, alert-data flow and retention, deployed consent and GA4 settings, and logs/vendors/incident handling. Keep rights outreach unsent pending owner authorization and human-counsel review. Permit only bounded reversible work that adds no new data collection, permissions, credentials, dependencies, or cross-site behavior.
